name: Midcoast Internet
summary: Port Macquarie / Mid North Coast NSW dialup ISP (midcoast.com.au, site live by Nov 1995); Defunct. NOTE: distinct from MediaCraft Interactive (mci.com.au). Research suggests it later merged into Central Connect's 'Coull Network' (Dec 2022) (ECOPOST PTY LIMITED, ACN 073 752 137).

events.details: Defunct. Ecopost's Midcoast/Mid North Coast Internet was absorbed into Central Connect (Coull Network) with the Dec 2022 merger; the domain redirected to the successor by late 2023.

refs.label: Same operator (Ecopost) still retailing NBN/ADSL on midcoast.com.au in 2016
By Nov 2023 midcoast.com.au meta-refreshes to Central Connect
